title: EmoBench: Evaluating the Emotional Intelligence of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces 'Emotional Application' as a key dimension of its benchmark, which requires LLMs to identify the 'most effective course of action or response within an emotional dilemma.' This task involves making judgments about appropriate social behavior and decision-making in interpersonal scenarios, which inherently touches upon ethical considerations. The authors also explicitly state their work is 'in line with previous research on LLMs’ commonsense (Sap et al., 2019) and morality (Jiang et al., 2021),' confirming the relevance of morality.
